title: Fractional Slider
author: Rauno Freiberg

fresh_visual_review.method: Every original native frame inspected in9 ordered full-canvas contact sheets at300px wide, plus three native-resolution keys. No fps resampling.

recommendation: Clean drawable signed-number ruler with fine fractional scrubbing, soft edge fade, selected blue range and animated return to zero. More reconstructable than wallpaper-backed Precision Slider. Treat this as one example.

observations.behavior: Ruler centered at0 with fixed white point below. Pointer enters from above/left and changes to horizontal bidirectional resize cursor below the ruler.

Blue press ring appears and pointer moves right. Ruler translates right, placing increasingly negative numbers under the fixed center point. Blue marks fill the interval between center selection and0.
Press ring fades and pointer returns leftward while negative ruler position briefly holds near−40.

Ruler continues toward the−90 endpoint while pointer remains near the same x position. Finite left endpoint moves from far left to the fixed center point; space left of−90 becomes blank. Exact input cause of this segment is not visible.
Endpoint−90 holds at center, selected marks to its right remain blue.
Ruler moves rapidly left from negative endpoint, across0, into positive values. Blue range moves to the left of the selected point. Labels vary in opacity with horizontal fade envelope.
Positive value settles near+55 while pointer approaches center under the ruler.
Two press rings appear around the stationary cursor; ruler rapidly returns toward0. This is consistent with a double-click reset but the exact trigger requires prototype verification.
Press ring fades and ruler finishes easing to0. Blue interval contracts and disappears.
Final ruler centered at0, fixed white point; pointer remains lower-right of center.

geometry_notes.confidence: Manual native-resolution anchors, approximate2px. No confirmed endpoint overshoot; do not invent elastic bouncing.

limits: No external wallpaper or photo source dependency. All marks, labels, cursor/rings and fading can be independently drawn.
Exact motion must preserve time sequence including endpoint hold and late reset, not just a generic draggable ruler.
Individual X post URL not verified; source is author-hosted page and original video.
No source-asset redistribution license identified. Keep original footage/crops local-analysis only.
